'''Pii IV''', also named '''Pii 4''' or '''Pii4''', was a logging [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Pii system/Legends|Pii system]] in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was one of "[[Teeda's Eyes]]."

==Description==
Pii IV,<ref name="Core">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> also known as Pii 4<ref name="Greel">{{JournalCite|6|The Greel Wood Haven}}</ref> or Pii4,<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> was a lush [[Color|green]]<ref name="CSWEPii">{{CSWECite|III|26|Pii system}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] withnin the [[Pii system/Legends|Pii system]]. The planet was located in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]]<ref name="Greel" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas" /> Pii IV, like the rest of the Pii system, was a seven-[[Standard day/Legends|day]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] journey away from the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]<ref name="Greel" /> and along the [[Old Corellian Run]] and the [[Trans Gulf Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. The Pii system, and therefore Pii IV, was originally located on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. When that hyperspace route changed its course<ref name="Atlas" /> at some point between around [[11,000 BBY]] and [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]<ref name="OldCorellianRunDate" /> and as a result no longer ran through the Pii system, the planet remained on the Old Corellian Run.<ref name="Atlas" />

Pii IV was the fourth planet from the [[Pii sun]], taking 361 [[Local day/Legends|local days]]&mdash;which measured twenty-one [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]]&mdash;to [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. The planet had a [[Temperature/Legends|cool]] temperature, averaged 900 [[Meter/Legends|centimeters]] of precipitation annually, and had a moist [[Hydrosphere/Legends|hydrosphere]]. It had with [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] terrain with sharp peaks and valleys.<ref name="Greel" />

==History==
Entrepreneur [[Meysen Kayson]] purchased the rights to [[Pii III]] and Pii IV during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Greel" />&mdash;which reorganization into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="Chrono">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>&mdash;with the intention of founding a bi-planetary nature preserve. During the initial construction of the preserve, the [[greel tree]] was discovered. Kayson consulted [[xenoarborist]]s and [[xenobotanist]]s and discovered the [[Tree/Legends|tree's]] unique properties, spurring him to implement a [[logging]] program through the [[Greel Wood Logging Corporation]].<ref name="Greel" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pii IV was first mentioned, albeit unnamed, in ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]'', a [[1984]] reference book authored by [[Raymond L. Velasco]].<ref name="Guide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> It was later identified as "Pii 4" in "[[The Greel Wood Haven]]," an article featured in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 6|sixth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] magazine that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[May]] of [[1995]] for their ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The article provided an adventure seed set on Pii IV<ref name="Greel" /> and this article assumes the adventure occurs as described. The planet was identified again but as "Pii4" in [[Stephen J. Sansweet]]'s<ref name="SWE" /> [[1998]]<ref name="ThisWeek">{{ThisWeek|-BZX-WxjhFE|San Diego Comic-Con Exclusives, Brand New LEGO Art, and More!|sw_url=video/san-diego-comic-con-exclusives-brand-new-lego-art-and-more|date=2020-07-02}}</ref> reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="SWE" /> It was finally identified as "Pii IV" in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|Core Rulebook]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Core" />  The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Pii system, and therefore its fourth planet, in grid square R-16.<ref name="Atlas" />
